survey.what_is_it: library/engine — header-only C++20 identity substrate; the native half of Tonality's dual implementation, plus an optional pybind11 fast path

architecture_rung.earned_by: Chosen, not defaulted (kit forbids defaulting this). 766 lines of header behind ONE byte-exact oracle over a 4096-input domain: verification is instant and total, the search space is tiny, and there are no parallelizable seams to hand a verifier. Rung 2 becomes arguable only if the Phase 6 fence moves and new slices need independent verification.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: All of it. The set-class arithmetic (Rahn normal order / prime form, interval vector, DFT, chirality family, Z-relation) AND the byte-exact reproduction of CPython's floating point (compiled-in FMA fusion, Neumaier-compensated sum(), libm pow through an optimization barrier). Fixtures and PIN are engine-owned; this repo reproduces, never re-derives.

oracle_shape.goldens: strict pinned goldens — 4096 rows x 16 fields byte-for-byte, plus every field of the set_class_info conformance case within rel 1e-9 / abs 1e-12. An unrecognized case field fails the harness so engine growth is loud.
oracle_shape.ci: matrix — macos-15 canonical (byte-exact, pinned to the fixture-generating image) + ubuntu-latest portability probe (all 4096 rows within tolerance, ints exact, phases compared as coefficients)

second_implementation.note: This repo IS the second implementation. The pure-Python engine is the spec's source of truth; the port pin lives in fixtures/PIN.json (engine 0c62809, export.2).

consumes: Tonality (provider; spec, fixtures, goldens, PIN — mailbox is ~/Documents/Tonality/integrations/tonality-core/)
consumed_by: Python consumers via the optional pybind11 module (an addition, never a replacement for the engine)
synthetic-worlds/FOUNDATIONS — prospective, reached by relay through Tonality today, not a direct exchange

lifespan_autonomy.lifespan: long-lived — the port half of a dual implementation, under Tonality's two-thread accountability protocol (port/PORT.md)
lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: Autonomous work is permitted within the Phase 6 fence: reproduce fixtures, keep the PIN green, answer exchanges. Fixture and golden regeneration happen ONLY on the Tonality side. Watcher refresh PRs land only on green CI. Pushes are the human's.
